texto: When spelling in Dutch it is very common to find the «ij» digraph (called «lange ij», unlike «ei» or «korte ei»). When a letter appears repeated, it is said «dubbel» (e.g. «dubbel o»). If you don't understand how a personal data is written, you can cortedly ask: «Kunt u dat spellen?» (Can you spell that?).

frases.nl: Noor van Dijk. Kunt u mijn achternaam spellen?
frases.es: Noor van Dijk. ¿Puede deletrear mi apellido?
frases.en: Noor van Dijk. Can you spell my last name?

frases.nl: Natuurlijk. Wilt u de letters herhalen?
frases.en: Sure. Do you want to repeat the letters?

frases.nl: Dank u, ik schrijf het langzaam op.
frases.en: Thank you, I'll put it on slowly.

bloques.pregunta: In Dutch, what does the expression «lange ij» refer to when spelling?

opciones.explicacion: It is called «lange ij» to be graphically differentiated from the «ei» digraph («korte ei»).
The simple «and» is usually called «Griekse ij» or «i-grec».
It is not a double «j», but the combination of «i» and «j».

bloques.pregunta: What does the client request from the employee?

opciones.texto: Can you spell my last name?
opciones.explicacion: «Achternaam» is the last name and «spellen» is spelling.

opciones.texto: Can you sign my employment contract?
opciones.explicacion: He's not talking about signing any documents.

opciones.texto: Can you repeat your phone number?
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't ask for numbers or phones.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the right word for «the letters».

opciones.explicacion: «De letters» is the regular plural of «letter» (letter).
It is in singular and the «de» article with plural sense requires «letters».
«Dubbel» is an adjective that means double, not the substantive letters.
It is the family name that follows the first name («voornaam»).

bloques.pregunta: What does the employee say with this sentence?
bloques.frase: Dank u, ik schrijf het langzaam op.

opciones.texto: Thank you, I'll put it on slowly.
opciones.explicacion: «Opschrijven» is write or write, and «langzaam» is slow.

opciones.texto: Thank you, I read it quickly.
opciones.explicacion: He says the opposite: he is not reading quickly but writing calmly.

opciones.texto: Thank you, I can't record your data.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase states that it is pointing it out.

bloques.explicacion: Formal question of courtesy with question pronoun «wat».

intro: It deletes names and last names and clarifies special photographs in Dutch.
